Implementer notes (Claude Opus 5.5, the lead in this session). Use them as context only; the judgment is yours.

- The feature was motivated by the Harne8 batch of 2026-11-22. There, every review round re-ran a 72-check matrix of about 35 minutes, and intermittent suites failed roughly one run in three.
- In this repository `pose-mcp` holds 233 of the 236 checks and is high criticality, so `--carry` saves little here. The dogfood record at c4182727 carried five of six modules with zero changed files.
- Please challenge the soundness argument of D1 in particular. A carried result is bound to the material computed at HEAD, and that is only safe when the selection guarantees the carried module's inputs did not change.
- Please also check the derived-record exclusion (`carryExclusions` with `posemodel.IsAdministrativePath`) and the engine identity, which is the version plus the VCS revision.
- Report every finding you see in this round, each classified as blocker or follow-up.

Round 2 notes:
- F1 from round 1 (rrn-0dd98c4aab8b5918) is addressed in d601fbe1. The record now has `material_clean`, set when the working copy matched HEAD at the start and at the end of the run. `planCarry` refuses a base without it, or with any unavailable material binding. `TestCarryRefusesABaseThatValidatedADirtyWorkingCopy` reproduces your sequence: a pass over an uncommitted fix, a commit of the record alone, the restored failing file, then `--carry`. The test failed with the check mutated out. Account for F1 in prior_findings.
- Round 1 also changed files in the sealed worktree because `pose assess integrate` and `pose assess tech-debt` persist their outputs: `.pose/assessments/*`, `.pose/state/*`. Run every `assess` command on a copy in the operation's scratch, never in the sealed checkout, and keep the Bash working directory at the checkout root. Example: `scratch=$(mktemp -d "$TMPDIR/pose-assess.XXXXXX")`, `git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$scratch"`, `sh -c 'cd "$1" && exec "$2" assess integrate --json' sh "$scratch" "$(command -v pose)"`.
- The `artifact-check` head differs from the bundle subject because the index commits also carry this spec's trailer. `artifact-check` resolves the change set range to the last trailer commit, which is an index-only commit. The bundle subject skips commits that only touch derived records, whose material digest is unchanged. That is existing engine behaviour, which the lead will take up separately. Judge it as you see fit.
- The full matrix takes about 13 minutes. If you cannot complete it in the sandbox, cite the sealed canonical result for the `validate` tool and state your own run's limits.

Round 3 notes: round 2 (rrn-1c033e4c349d7794) found N1–N4. 2077731b fixes them:
- The changed set uses `git diff -z --no-renames` and `ls-files -z`, so a rename names both sides and a quoted name keeps its owner.
- The root module `.` is never exempt from root files.
- A build with `vcs.modified=true` is not a verifiable identity: it never carries, and a base with a `.dirty` identity is refused.

The regression tests are `TestCarrySelectsBothSidesOfARename`, `TestCarryKeepsTheOwnerOfAQuotedName`, `TestCarryRootModuleOwnsRootFiles` and `TestEngineIdentityRefusesModifiedBuilds`. Each one failed with its fix mutated out. Account for R2-N1..R2-N4 in prior_findings.

Round 4 notes: round 3 (rrn-3461f6ff36909419) found N5 and N6.
- N5: a declared `dependsOn` path now owns its files even when the dependency is no longer discovered (`underDeclaredDependency`).
- N6: module metadata that does not decode is now an error. It means a full run under `--carry` and exit 2 under `--changed-from`.
The regression tests are `TestCarryDeletedDependencySelectsItsDependents` and `TestCarryRejectsUndecodableMetadata`. Both failed with their fix mutated out. Account for R3-N5 and R3-N6 in prior_findings.

Please make this round an exhaustive sweep and report every remaining issue in it, each classified as blocker or follow-up, so the scope can converge. Cover at least:
- gitlinks and submodules;
- symlinks;
- paths that differ only by case;
- `moduleOverrides` modules that have no manifest;
- nested modules;
- a module whose matrix checks or stack change while the matrix digest does not;
- criticality and policy widening;
- chained carries over many bases;
- concurrent runs writing the canonical file.
- The lead's own sweep before this round found a gitlink case: a changed gitlink above a declared dependency selected nothing under it. A changed path now selects the modules and dependencies under it, tested by `TestChangedScopeGitlinkAboveADependencySelectsItsDependents`.

Round 5 notes: round 4 (rrn-4b28f2ff95acf9c4) found N7–N10. The selection in `computeChangedScope` was rewritten instead of patched. Each changed file now independently selects:
- its most specific owner;
- every module beneath it;
- every module whose declared dependency contains it, lies beneath it or is the root `.`, when that dependency is not a discovered module, which the transitive widening covers;
- for a file no module owns, the root module and every module that is not self-contained.

`planCarry` refuses when any module is reached through a symlink. `material_clean` now also requires the HEAD at the end of the run to equal the recorded head. The regression tests are `TestCarryDeletedNestedDependencySelectsItsDependents`, `TestCarryRootDependencyIsChangedByRootFiles`, `TestCarryRefusesModulesReachedThroughASymlink` and `TestValidateHeadMovingDuringTheRunIsNotClean`. Each failed with its fix mutated out. Account for R4-N7..R4-N10 in prior_findings, and again report every remaining issue in this round.

Round 6 notes: round 5 (rrn-b07ee93779a65e40) found N11–N14.
- N11: every eligible dependency now counts (`declaredDependencyHits`).
- N12: a run whose HEAD moved, or that is otherwise not `material_clean`, records every material binding as unavailable.
- N13: `aliasedModule` also refuses modules that share a physical directory (`os.SameFile`).
- N14: the head is pinned before planning, and `planCarry`, the selection and the exclusions use that SHA.
The regression tests are `TestChangedScopeEvaluatesEveryDeclaredDependency`, `TestValidateHeadMovingDuringTheRunBindsNoMaterial`, `TestCarryRefusesModulesSharingADirectory` and `TestCarryPlansAgainstThePinnedHead`. Each failed with its fix mutated out. Account for R5-N11..R5-N14 and the remaining partials R3-N9/R3-N10 in prior_findings, and report every remaining issue in this round.
